Hi there,

Nothing is being cancelled. Your order stays exactly as it is, and it will ship as planned.

I just want to be sure I'm looking at the right one before I confirm anything else. Could you reply with your order number (something like Shop····) plus either the name it ships to or the postcode? With that I'll pull it up and send you the current ship date and tracking as soon as there is any.

If you had asked us to cancel earlier and have changed your mind, say so in your reply and I'll make sure the order is left untouched.

Thanks, and sorry for the back and forth.
